title: The Multicultural Medical Assistant: Can LLMs Improve Medical ASR Errors Across Borders?

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing transcription accuracy using Word Error Rate (WER) and Medical Concept Word Error Rate (MC-WER) across datasets featuring medical conversations in Nigerian, British (along with various European/Indian), and American accents to measure performance disparities in ASR and LLM correction systems.

Evaluating the performance of commercial and open-source ASR models and LLMs on region-specific healthcare datasets (Nigeria, UK, and US) to identify training data biases favoring Western or US-centric speech patterns.
